content:
This chapter includes several start-to-ﬁnish tutorials for working with Amazon OpenSearch
Service, including how to migrate to the service, build a simple search application, and create a
visualization in OpenSearch Dashboards.
Topics
• Tutorial: Creating and searching for documents in Amazon OpenSearch Service
• Tutorial: Migrating to Amazon OpenSearch Service
• Tutorial: Creating a search application with Amazon OpenSearch Service
• Tutorial: Visualizing customer support calls with OpenSearch Service and OpenSearch
Dashboards
